scope: Offline close receipt for the append-only no-go evidence index; not an evaluation, replication, training, release, or SOTA result.

failure_ledger.failure: The frozen P6 manifest predates the later P3 v2 evidence chain.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: Editing the frozen manifest would destroy its historical no-go provenance.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Create a separate hash-pinned index that recursively preserves the P6 decision and later bounded evidence.
failure_ledger.evidence: The index loads the immutable P6 decision and retains all six blocker IDs and four false no-go flags.
failure_ledger.limitation: The index cannot make P6-C1 through P6-C4 or any P5 outcome green.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Delete only the index and this close receipt if invalid; never rewrite the frozen P6 package.

failure_ledger.failure: A single v2 structural tool record could be misread as active-agent, chemical, or comparative evidence.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: Explicit state gates prevent provenance packaging from becoming claim promotion.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Require the exact P3 isolation, P5 eligibility red state, P6 no-go flags, and claim-status register.
failure_ledger.evidence: Focused tamper validation rejects a P5 eligibility promotion before any external action.
failure_ledger.limitation: The check is offline and cannot characterize a provider, CLI, chemistry task, or held-out study.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Any source, hash, status, or authority drift invalidates the index rather than updating its conclusion.

failure_ledger.failure: The first standalone index-validator draft had a local entry-point typo.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: The imported harness test alone does not prove the reproducibility command works.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Correct the entry point before the focused harness test and run the standalone validator once.
failure_ledger.evidence: The focused test passed 2 tests in 0.05 s and the standalone command passed after correction; no external call occurred.
failure_ledger.limitation: Command execution proves only local offline validation.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Delete the index artifacts rather than modifying frozen P6/P3 evidence.

focused_test.command: env -u PYTHONPATH conda run --no-capture-output -n chemsmart python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/agent/harness/test_frontier_evidence_index.py -q

standalone_validator.command: env -u PYTHONPATH conda run --no-capture-output -n chemsmart python scripts/review/validate_frontier_evidence_index.py --repo .
